offers_products.reason: Manufactures and sells natural gas compressors (CiP brand), though rental is larger; sales are a named offering.

offers_services.reason: Rents compressors to operators and provides maintenance services for them; rental is the larger business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are oil and natural gas producers; no households buy compression equipment.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Rents and sells compressors to oil and gas production companies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is recurring monthly compressor rental fees on a fleet exceeding 500,000 horsepower.

cyclical_demand.reason: Oil and gas producers cut drilling and compression needs when commodity prices fall; demand tied to production capex.

big_ticket.reason: Main business is monthly rental of compressors, small recurring payments, though occasional compressor sales are large.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay mainly for rented compressor equipment and its SMART technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are oil and gas producers of mixed size; website does not say whether large enterprises dominate.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns and continually builds a rental compressor fleet exceeding 500,000 horsepower, requiring heavy capital investment.

notes: Customer size is not stated on the website; rental is judged the larger business over manufacturing and sales.
